headline: FIRE CREW — three seats, one burning warehouse, and the smoke decides who sees what
lede: An original co-op firefighting game landed: fire creeps cell-by-cell with the wind, floors burn out into holes, and the loft is only visible to whoever holds the ladder. Solo you run the hose against two autopilot crewmates; on a couch, three keyboards and one radio's worth of shouting.

notes.text: FIRE CREW shipped from #1254 (PR #1360): seeded 2:00 shifts, six victims, HOSE/RESCUE/LADDER seats, every seat human/CPU/model-capable, 480x320 with all art and sound synthesized at runtime.
The darkness is a rule, not a filter: one lightAt() law decides both what the player sees and when a victim counts as found — the split-information bargain the issue asked for.

New gates: firecrewcheck (33 rules incl. autopilot wins >=8/10 seeds, mutant-proven) and firecrewplay (real-key drive: start, play, pause, contract step, die, restart) — plus FIRE CREW joins contractcheck, nightlybot and attractcheck mutants.
Main spent the early shift red on harness drift (#1350 fixed it mid-session); nightlybot still hand-copies the contract roster — importing it outright is the obvious forge-watch follow-up.
